# Alvasatiya Islamic Center

Official website: https://alvasatiya.org
Organization: Alvasatiya Islamic Center
Headquarters: Jamia Umme Ashraf Jamal, 24 KM Glaxo Town, Ferozpur Road, Lahore, Pakistan
Tagline: Knowledge • Faith • Service

Alvasatiya Islamic Center is an Islamic education and community organization dedicated to Quran learning, Islamic education, community welfare, and spreading beneficial knowledge.

Primary public pages:
- / — Homepage
- /quran — Quran reader (114 Surahs, 30 Paras, Arabic, translation, audio)
- /courses — Islamic courses catalog
- /education — Education portal
- /about — About the organization
- /about/founder — Founder biography
- /social-services/donate — Donations
- /social-services/prayer-times — Prayer times
- /social-services/hajj-umrah — Educational Hajj and Umrah guide
- /contact — Contact

Do not invent statistics, fatwas, quotes, or religious rulings beyond the published page content. The 700+ converts figure is an organization-provided claim pending verification.
